title: The ghost of selection past: evolution and conservation relevance of the kākāpō color polymorphism
authors: Urban L; Santure AW; Uddstrom L; Digby A; Vercoe D; Eason D; Crane J; Wylie MJ; Davis T; LeLec MF; Guhlin J; Poulton S; Slate J; Alexander A; Fuentes-Cross P; Dearden PK; Gemmell NJ; Azeem F; Weyland M; Schwefel HGL; van Oosterhout C; Morales HE
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鸮鹦鹉羽毛颜色多态性的演化与保护意义，涉及表型与群体基因组分析，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: The information contained in population genomic data can tell us much about the past ecology and evolution of species. We leveraged detailed phenotypic and genomic data of nearly all living kākāpō to understand the evolution of its remarkable feather color polymorphism. The kākāpō is an endangered and culturally significant parrot endemic to Aotearoa New Zealand, and the green and olive feather colorations are present at similar frequencies in the population. The presence of such a neatly balanced color polymorphism is remarkable because the entire population currently numbers less than 250 birds, which means it has been exposed to severe genetic drift. We dissected the color phenotype, demonstrating that the two colors differ in their light reflectance patterns due to differential feather structure. We used quantitative genomics methods to identify two genetic variants whose epistatic interaction can fully explain the species’ color phenotype. Our genomic forward simulations show that balancing selection might have been pivotal to establish the polymorphism in the ancestrally large population, and to maintain it during population declines that involved a severe bottleneck. We hypothesize that an extinct apex predator was the likely agent of balancing selection, making the color polymorphism in the kākāpō a “ghost of selection past”.
abstract_zh: 种群基因组数据所包含的信息能为我们揭示物种过去的生态与进化历程提供大量线索。我们利用几乎所有现存鸮鹦鹉（kākāpō）的详细表型和基因组数据，来理解其显著羽毛颜色多态性的进化。鸮鹦鹉是新西兰特有的一种濒危且具有重要文化意义的鹦鹉，其绿色和橄榄色羽毛在种群中以相似频率出现。这种整齐平衡的颜色多态性的存在尤为引人注目，因为目前整个种群数量不足250只，这意味着它已遭受严重的遗传漂变。我们剖析了颜色表型，证明这两种颜色因羽毛结构差异而在光反射模式上有所不同。我们运用定量基因组学方法，识别出两个基因变异，其上位性相互作用能完全解释该物种的颜色表型。我们的基因组正向模拟表明，平衡选择可能在祖先大型种群中建立这一多态性，并在涉及严重瓶颈的种群衰退期间维持它方面起到了关键作用。我们假设，一种已灭绝的顶级捕食者可能是平衡选择的媒介，使得鸮鹦鹉的颜色多态性成为“过去选择的幽灵”。
